instructionSplits.rule: An instruction contains an Ingredients- label and a later Method- label. Lines between them join ingredients when not already present. Lines after Method- become the instructions. A line in ingredients that repeats a method sentence is removed. Blocks without both labels are left alone.

before.name: Latkes Full Of Love!
ingredients: 4 shredded russet potatoes( drain the liquid)🥔🥔
instructions:
Ingredients- 
4 shredded russet potatoes( drain the liquid)🥔🥔
1/2 shredded sweet onion 🧅
1 tablespoon of chopped dill 
1 egg
3 tablespoons of all purpose flour 
1 teaspoon of baking powder
1.5 teaspoon of salt 
1/4 teaspoon of black pepper 

Method- 
Mix all the ingredients in a bowl

🌟Frying- 
In a pan on a low medium heat, pour 3/4 cup of vegetable oil

When the oil is hot, 
use a spoon to scoop from the latke mixture, put in the oil and fry the latkes from both sides until they are golden

🌟Baking- 
On a baking sheet put parchment paper, spray the parchment paper with oil, place the latkes  and spray oil on top

before.name: SHAWARMA SPICED SALMON CUBES!
ingredients: 2.5 pounds of fresh salmon, cut to thick cubes
instructions:
Recipe:
Ingredients-
2.5 pounds of fresh salmon, cut to thick cubes 
1 cup of cherry tomatoes 
Handful of chopped parsley and mint leaves 
1 sliced shallot 
Slices of 1/2 Lemon 
1/4 sliced jalapeño pepper

Seasoning-
1/4 cup of olive oil
Juice from 1/2 lemon
1 teaspoon of paprika 
1 teaspoon of sumac 
4 minced garlic cloves 
1 teaspoon of salt
1 teaspoon of shawarma spice 
1 tablespoon of Dijon mustard 
1 tablespoon of honey 
Put all the ingredients in a bowl and mix it well

Method-
Preheat the oven to 400F
In an oven safe rectangular pan, place the salmon cubes, herbs, shallot, jalapeños, cherry tomatoes and lemon slices
Pour the sauce on top and mix it all well
Cover with wet parchment paper

before.name: MOROCCAN CARROT SALAD!
instructions:
Recipe:
Ingredients- 
10-12 carrots, peeled and washed 
1 teaspoon of salt 

Dressing-
1/4 cup of olive oil
1 tablespoon of honey
1 teaspoon of ground coriander 
1/2 teaspoon of Ras El Hanut 
1 teaspoon of salt 
Juice from 1/2 lemon 
2 minced garlic cloves 
1/2 teaspoon of harissa paste 
Put all the ingredients in a bowl and mix well

Garnish-
Handful of chopped cilantro 
1 slice of lemon, cut to quarters with no seeds
Handful of chopped walnuts 

Method- 
In a large pot, place the carrots and the salt
On the stove on high heat, boil the carrots for 10 minutes or until they’re soft but still have some bite to them
Drain, let it dry and cool

titleFixes.rule: A title is replaced only when it is a sign-off, a call to action, or a sentence rather than a dish name, and the title or caption already contains one unambiguous dish line. The new title is that line. No title is invented. A renamed record that then matches a newer copy of the same recipe (same title rule, ingredient containment 1) is dropped instead of shown twice.

before.name: ONE-PAN BEEF, CORN AND PTITIM!
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until it starts to soften. Season with salt, black pepper, turmeric, and garlic powder, and stir for about 30 seconds.
Add the ground beef. Using a wooden spoon break it up and stir occasionally, until browned. About 7-8 minutes.
Stir in the frozen corn, p’titim, chopped dill and cilantro, and date syrup. Mix well, then pour in the boiling water and stir again.

Cover with a lid, reduce heat to low, and cook until the liquid is absorbed and the p’titim is tender. If it looks dry before the p’titim is soft, add a small splash of water and keep cooking covered.

before.name: ARUK ARAYES!
ingredients: 6 golden potatoes, peeled and cooked until very soft
6 scallions (green onions), finely chopped, including the green part
instructions: In a bowl mash the cooked potatoes to a slightly chunky consistency and let them cool slightly.
Add the scallions, parsley, ground beef, salt, pepper, turmeric, garlic powder, baharat and egg. Mix very well until evenly combined.
Open up each pita half and stuff it with the Beef Aruk mixture.
On the stove on medium heat, pour 5 tablespoons of olive oil into a grilling pan.

before.name: MY VIRAL OVEN-BAKED SCHNITZEL
ingredients: 2 pounds of of thin chicken cutlets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 420°F (220°C).
In a large bowl, combine the chicken cutlets, eggs, salt, pepper, paprika, cumin, Dijon mustard, honey, lemon juice, lemon zest, and garlic. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated.
In a separate dish, mix the panko, breadcrumbs, sesame seeds, and garlic powder. Coat each cutlet on both sides, pressing the crumbs gently onto the chicken.
Arrange the cutlets in a single layer on a baking pan. Drizzle the olive oil over them.
